messages:
Sam (AE): Heads-up — Concord wants to run a migration POC from RivalAI -> Redwood. Lena (their tech lead) asked for a drop-in compat layer, prompt parity checks, answers to their security questionnaire (SOC2/KMS/SAML), and a pricing delta for committed Dedicated vs hosted. Can we demo with a small corpus next week? Lena looped in below.

Lena (Concord-Eng): Hi all — yes. Quick profile: ~3M tokens/month steady, bursts to ~2k qps, chat flows built on RivalAI /v1/complete + embeddings for search. Biggest issues historically: stop-token semantics differ and RivalAI includes a metadata blob in every response. We need prompt-level parity for 200 canonical prompts. Can Redwood return the same 'id'/'created' fields or should we map? Also need KMS + 1yr audit log retention + SAML.

Priya (SE): We can provide a compat proxy that maps RivalAI shapes to Redwood responses. Two routes: lightweight shim (nginx + transform) or an SDK adapter. For parity tests I can run our diffsuite — pls upload sample prompts + RivalAI outputs. We have a script: `tools/compat_diff.sh` that checks tokenization, stop handling, and a heuristic similarity score.

Lena (Concord-Eng): I'll upload 200 prompts + outputs to the shared folder by EOD. Do you need exact HTTP shape, headers, and example error codes?

Priya (SE): Yes please — include a few error cases (rate-limit, 413 payload too large). For stop token parity we compare both token sequence and final text. Example quick test curl (drop-in shim):

```bash
curl -X POST https://proxy.redwood.local/v1/complete \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <POC_TOKEN>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"model":"rivalai-3b","prompt":"Translate to french: hello","max_tokens":50}'
```

Our shim returns RivalAI-shaped JSON and maps Redwood fields accordingly. If you prefer, we can also provide a tiny Node adapter you can run in their infra.

Omar (Security): I'll own the security questionnaire. Quick checklist for the team: SOC2 report (redacted) — we provide on NDA/MSA; KMS options: hosted (Redwood-managed), customer KMS via Private deployment, or HSM in Dedicated. Questions: do they require SSE-C or an HSM-backed key? If yes, Private deploy likely. Also clarify data residency (which region) and audit log retention.

Tom (CSM): Pricing note: rough hosted run-rate for 3M tokens at public hosted rates ~= $0.0008/token -> ~$2.4k/mo. Dedicated estimate is more infra-dependent — I'll produce a committed quote once we know concurrency/latency SLOs and model family. SLA ask of 99.9% ok but will need to push for Dedicated with commit.

Priya (SE): I'll run parity POC after samples are in. ETA 48h for initial report. I'll run `compat_diff.sh` and post a diff summary (pass/fail per prompt with similarity score). If we see systematic tokenization/stopping mismatches we can add a post-processing step in the shim.

Sam (AE): Great. Action items: I will request the security questionnaire and samples from Lena. @Omar can you own the sec responses? @Tom can you prepare a committed Dedicated estimate if parity looks good?

Omar (Security): I can take security. Quick Q: do we require an NDA before sending SOC2? We typically request an MSA/LOU for full reports but can send a redacted SOC2 on request. Also confirm if they need data deletion APIs — we have `DELETE /v1/objects/:id` for stored artifacts; I'll verify exact endpoint.

DevBot: Reminder — created POC artifacts bucket: s3://redwood-pocs/concord-1823456789 (retention 30d).

Lena (Concord-Eng): Thanks — uploading prompts now. Also latency target: p95 < 200ms for chat. Is that realistic with 2k qps bursts?

Priya (SE): For p95 <200ms at bursts we'd recommend Dedicated with autoscale and KV prefix caching enabled. Short config snippet we recommend for the POC: 

```json
{
  "routing_policy": "latency",
  "model": "redwood-chat-7b-opt",
  "batching": {"max_tokens": 512, "max_batch_size": 8},
  "cache": {"prefix_kv": true}
}
```

That plus a 2x GPU pool and small batch sizing should hit the p95 target in our benchmarks. We'll run a load test as part of the POC.

Sam (AE): Next steps: I'll send an updated quote + MSA draft to Concord today. Priya will run the diffs when samples arrive. Omar will start on the sec questionnaire. If Private/KMS is required we'll loop in the product/ops team for on-prem options.

Lena (Concord-Eng): Appreciate the quick turnaround. I'll post the sample zip and questionnaire link here in ~2 hours and ping when done.

Priya (SE): :thumbsup:

Tom (CSM): I'll prep a placeholder Dedicated estimate and a hosted vs committed cost comparison to share after the parity pass.

Sam (AE): Thanks everyone — updating CRM with these action items and ETA.
